verdicts.why: held: minor employer. Her candy shop is a small family business seen once (Ironheart episode 4), so the paired shop stage is an open owner question; until then the record stands: she trained at Kamar-Taj and says on screen she left it to raise Zelma, so Independent with a left at Ironheart is right.

held: minor employer. Working the counter of her mother's candy and magic shop is a minor family job (the same open owner question as Alexei's limo company and the paramedics), so Independent stays for now.
held: minor employer. Gary's own garage is seen only in flashbacks in Ironheart episode 1, and the screen calls it 'the garage' rather than a firm name, so it stays an open owner question.

The Resistance's last strike ends with only Logan and Wade going through Cassandra's portal, the group is finished (Marvel Database: Resistance 'Defunct', Logan 'Formerly: Resistance, X-Men'), and Logan stays on Wade's world with no group. This matches Wade and Laura's records for the same title and an earlier confirmed check.
Goes with item 37: the Resistance ends in Deadpool & Wolverine and Logan ends in no group, so left gets 'Deadpool & Wolverine', the same as Wade and Laura.

Held owner call: Void variants whose home world is never shown carry no Earth for now (Dogpool, Nicepool, Ladypool are on the held list). Marvel Database's own Reality field for Mary Puppins reads 'Unknown' (currently displaced to Earth-10005); Earth-TRN872 is only its page label. So the null stays until the owner rules.

In Venom, Anne warns Eddie not to repeat 'the Daily Globe incident', which tells his past job as a Daily Globe reporter in New York, ending when he was fired. A newspaper is a real employer (like the Daily Bugle). A past group goes first, keyed to his first title.
Same person as A:sv-eddie-brock-sony. A person's hero and villain files list the same groups, so the Daily Globe past stage goes first here too.

Same person as A:shalla-bal (one person, one bubble per HANDOFF). In First Steps she comes to Earth as Galactus's herald and then turns on him, pushing him into the portal, so the villain file should carry the same Heralds of Galactus then Independent stages and left.

Morbius founded and is director of Horizon Labs, where he treats patients and runs his experiments throughout the film. That makes it his real firm, not a one-off job. Ending the film as a fugitive is not a departure.
Same person as A:sv-michael-morbius. Hero and villain files list the same groups, so Horizon Labs from the start.
Martine is a doctor and researcher at Horizon Labs who works beside Michael throughout Morbius (Marvel Database affiliation: Horizon Labs). Nothing on screen has her leave.
held: minor employer. Ben's paramedic job is already an open owner question (Ben, Cassie Webb and O'Neil's FDNY/paramedic stages are held together), so Independent stays for now.

B. Reilly Investigations and Reilly & Ruiz are the same firm, renamed in episode 8 when Janet becomes a partner, so this is no move. The record already has him leave the Army for the firm, under a correct name for it. This matches an earlier rejection of the same change.

Janet is Ben's secretary at his firm from episode 1 and becomes a partner when it is renamed Reilly & Ruiz in episode 8. That is the same firm under a later name, not a move. Her first title is Spider-Noir, so '(from the start)' already means Spider-Noir.

In 'If This Be My Destiny...' Peter quits his Oscorp internship after Project Monolith ('So, I guess your internship is over'), and Nico pitches Peter and Harry on starting their own company, which Harry then founds as W.E.B. Marvel Database says Harry founds W.E.B. 'alongside Peter', and the MCU wiki lists Peter as a member.

Penny's Place is her family's Vermont diner, which she ran before New York, seen in the Daredevil S3 episode 'Karen' flashback. As a past group it goes first, keyed to her first title, Daredevil S1. In S3 she goes from the Bulletin straight to Nelson, Murdock & Page.
